title: THE RE-ROLL TAX ON ONE LABEL
as12Exception: The embedded render is the subject of the slide (AS-8), so it is taller than 3x the headline cap height.

options.label: WITH AN IMAGE MODEL
options.text: Regenerate the whole image and hope. The leaves, icons, spacing and every other line of copy can drift, and the result is never the same twice.

options.label: WITH XYZ LAYOUT ENGINE
options.text: Edit one field in fixture.json and rerender. Every other element stays where it was, byte for byte, and the same input gives the same output.

disclosure: Shown: the nutrition infographic (nutrition@4.0.0), rendered by the engine at 1000 × 1000. Its seven illustrations are AI-generated cutouts (gpt-image-2.5-flare); the layout and type are not.
